detail.title: PS5 Dock5 Cooling & Dual Controller Charging Station - White
detail.overview: The Ant Esports Dock5 RGB is an all-in-one PS5 station combining a secure vertical stand, active cooling, dual controller charging and accessory storage in one compact unit, built for both PS5 Disc and Digital Edition consoles. High-speed cooling fans running up to 5200 RPM across 3 adjustable speeds improve airflow around the console, reducing heat buildup during long gaming sessions, while a dual charging dock powers up two DualSense controllers simultaneously in around 3 hours with LED status indicators. Dedicated storage for up to 6 game cases and a built-in headset holder keep accessories organized and within reach, and dynamic RGB lighting effects add a premium visual touch to the setup. A safety screw firmly secures the console to the stand, preventing accidental knocks, and a smart security chip protects against overvoltage, overcurrent and short circuits during charging.
